critical_code_review_comments: daily_task_routes.py POST /daily-tasks allows roles ['employee','admin'] but the new /customers and /progress endpoints allow ['employee','admin','super_admin']. Consider unifying role list (super_admin should also be able to create/log tasks for consistency).
DailyTasks.js: fetchTasks() inside handleSubmit is not awaited, which can cause a brief race for newly-created task to appear; consider `await fetchTasks()` and gating success banner after refresh.
closeTask() / submitProgress(): on non-OK response setError is set but error banner persists; consider auto-clearing after a few seconds or on next user action.

DailyTask model's `progress_notes` is List[ProgressNote]; backend pushes a plain dict {note, timestamp} - works because timestamp is ISO string parsable by Pydantic, but explicit ProgressNote(...).model_dump() would be safer.
Edit button (Edit2) is a bare icon with no aria-label - accessibility nit.
